name: Release 1 — five verified Naperville businesses
notes: Names, addresses, phone numbers, websites and talking points are as supplied by Mustafa.
No coordinates: none has been geocoded, so lat/lng are left out rather than guessed. The portal routes by the street address, which is what a person would type into Maps.
Every business starts at 'new'. No visit, contact or partnership is pre-filled.
Scripts make no promise of referrals, payment or a medical outcome.

businesses.name: Karve Pilates
businesses.address: 4827 S Illinois Route 59, Unit 105, Naperville, IL 60564
businesses.talkingPoint: Build a local community relationship between a Pilates studio and a family dental practice.

script.opening: Hi, I'm with the local outreach team representing Hyline Dental here in Naperville. We're introducing the practice to a few businesses in the community that we think could be a good fit. Would the owner or manager be open to a quick introduction?
script.introduction: Hyline Dental is a family dental practice on Route 59, just up the road from you. They look after general and family dentistry for people in this part of Naperville.
script.value: Your members already put time into looking after themselves, and we're building a small network of local independents who know and can point people toward each other. Nothing formal, nothing exclusive.
script.ask: Could we leave a few cards at the front desk, and would the owner be open to a short chat another time?

objections.busy: No problem at all — I'll leave these and a card. Is there a better morning to catch the owner?
objections.notInterested: Understood, thanks for your time. I'll leave a card in case it's ever useful.
objections.alreadyPartnered: That's good to hear. We're not asking anyone to drop anything — it's just so people know there's a dental practice nearby. I'll leave a card.

script.closing: Thanks very much. I'll note that I spoke with you, and we'll check back in a few weeks.
script.followUp: Hi, I came by a few weeks ago on behalf of Hyline Dental, the family practice on Route 59. I wanted to see whether the cards have been any use and whether the owner had a moment to say hello.
